page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s3 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. This instance is configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The underlying processor configuration for the ecs.s3.medium lacks advanced instruction sets and hardware-assisted technologies. Specifically, CPU flags for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and cryptographic acceleration (AES, SHA_NI) are unavailable. Hardware virtualization extensions (VMX, SVM) and hyper-threading are also absent. This hardware profile limits the instance's suitability for vector-heavy calculations, machine learning inference, or nested virtualization workloads, positioning it instead for basic, integer-focused processing tasks.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a low memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:1, the ecs.s3.medium offers a specialized hardware profile. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require dedicated processing threads but have minimal memory footprints. Suitable workloads include lightweight web serving, basic background workers, task queuing, and simple automation scripts that do not require local disk storage or advanced cryptographic and vector instructions.
